description: This source file is part of the Android Open Source Project, automatically generated, and contains JNI code for interfacing with EGL 1.4 and 1.5 classes and methods, including caching of method IDs, global references to EGL objects, and utility functions for handling EGL handles and buffers.

methods.name: nativeClassInit
methods.description: Initializes global references and method IDs for EGL classes and objects, and sets static EGL object references for EGL_NO_CONTEXT, EGL_NO_DISPLAY, and EGL_NO_SURFACE.

methods.name: getPointer
methods.description: Retrieves a native pointer from a Java NIO buffer or array, updating remaining size and offset.

methods.name: releasePointer
methods.description: Releases a native pointer obtained from a Java buffer, with optional commit.

methods.name: fromEGLHandle
methods.description: Converts a Java EGL object to a native EGL handle, throwing an exception if null.

methods.name: toEGLHandle
methods.description: Creates a Java EGL object from a native handle, returning predefined objects for EGL_NO_IMAGE.
